claims.label: Freud Letter Describes Ritual Abuse Scene
claims.claim: A letter from Sigmund Freud to Wilhelm Fliess describes a patient recalling ritual circumcision and concludes with Freud's reference to "a primeval devil religion" and "the harsh therapy of the witches' judges."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full Freud-Fliess correspondence from standard critical editions to verify the quote in full context.

claims.label: Epstein Emails Mention Israel Twice as Much as Trump
claims.claim: Per the TikTok contrarian compilation, Israel is mentioned twice as much as Donald Trump across the released Epstein documents.
claims.investigative_direction: Independently count Israel/Trump mentions across DOJ-released documents.

claims.label: Epstein Told Roger Schank Jews Create Wealth Through Financial Manipulation
claims.claim: Per the compilation, in a discussion with Jewish-American academic and hedge fund worker Roger Schank, Epstein stated that Jews create vast fortunes by manipulating markets, creating financial speculation, and exploiting labor.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the underlying email between Epstein and Roger Schank in DOJ releases.

claims.label: Joshua Finkelstein Accused of Treating Non-Jews as Not Human
claims.claim: Per the compilation, Joshua Finkelstein (described as BlackRock's Larry Finkelstein's son) is accused by his ex-girlfriend Svetlana of having "no respect for non-Jews" and of seeing them as not human; he also pressured her to have an abortion.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the underlying email and any corroborating testimony from Svetlana.

claims.label: Ghislaine Maxwell Called Epstein Residence "A Jewish Country Club"
claims.claim: Per Maria Farmer's on-camera statement in the compilation, when Maria Farmer called Ghislaine Maxwell to ask why she could not eat at Epstein's residence, Maxwell told her "It's a Jewish country club. You're not Jewish. They're not going to serve you."
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check against Maria Farmer's prior sworn testimony and DOJ documents.

claims.label: Epstein Emailed That He Works for the Rothschilds
claims.claim: Per host reading, an Epstein email stated "those are my bosses, the Rothschilds."
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the specific Epstein email in DOJ releases containing the Rothschild reference.

claims.label: Susan Hamblin Allegedly Emailed Epstein Permission to Kill
claims.claim: Per James Lee's analysis, an Epstein email poorly redacted but readable as from "Susan Hamblin" contains the line "I give you permission to kill him."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the unredacted email from DOJ sources; cross-check with prior News Group Newspapers reporting on Susan Hamblin.

claims.label: Susan Hamblin Previously Sued News Group Newspapers Over Epstein Allegations
claims.claim: Per James Lee, Susan Hamblin previously sued News Group Newspapers (publisher of The Sun) over articles alleging she groomed and procured a 16-year-old for Epstein; articles were removed and substantial compensation paid.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the litigation through court records (UK).

claims.label: Ben Shapiro Asserts FBI Not Releasing Epstein Tapes Because They Are Child Pornography
claims.claim: Per Ben Shapiro on camera, the FBI is not releasing Epstein tapes because the tapes are child pornography, not because they document third-party abuse.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Shapiro's claim to DOJ public statements and Todd Blanche's public statements on the tapes.

claims.label: Ben Shapiro Asserts No "Epstein List" Exists
claims.claim: Per Ben Shapiro on camera, citing his federal government sources, there is no Epstein list; the black book contacts are already public, and no evidence exists that third-party contacts trafficked girls.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check against DOJ/FBI official statements on what documents were released.

claims.label: Naftali Bennett Categorically Denies Mossad Operated Epstein Blackmail Ring
claims.claim: Per host-read Bennett statement, former Israeli PM Naftali Bennett stated with "100% certainty" that the accusation Mossad ran an Epstein blackmail ring is "categorically and totally false."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full Bennett interview recording.

claims.label: Naftali Bennett Cites Pollard 1987 as Last Mossad US Operation
claims.claim: Per host-read Bennett statement (following her own interview with Bennett), Mossad has not been active in the United States since the Jonathan Pollard scandal of 1987.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Bennett's claim against declassified or publicly known Mossad operations post-1987.

claims.label: Nicki Minaj Posted That Favorite Artist Practices in Satanic Cult with Baby Sacrifices
claims.claim: Nicki Minaj posted on X that "Your favorite artist has been practicing rituals in a satanic cult where they take babies from other countries and mutilate and kill them as a form of blood sacrifice to their God."
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Minaj's original post on X; identify which artist she is referencing (context suggests Jay-Z).

claims.label: Peter Thiel States He Was Introduced to Epstein by Reid Hoffman Around 2014
claims.claim: Per Peter Thiel on the Joe Rogan podcast, he was introduced to Jeffrey Epstein by Reid Hoffman in 2014 (after Epstein's 2008 arrest), described as "one of the smartest tax people in the world."
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm date and circumstances against any released Thiel email metadata with Hoffman.

claims.label: Peter Thiel Acknowledges "Moral Weakness" in Not Asking More Questions About Epstein
claims.claim: Per the Rogan exchange, Thiel states "it was probably my moral weakness" that he did not ask more questions about Epstein.

claims.label: Josh Hammer States Charlie Kirk Pro-Israel Text Was September 9
claims.claim: Per Josh Hammer on camera, Charlie Kirk's text expressing intent to abandon the pro-Israel cause was sent on September 9, 2025 — not September 8 as Candace Owens had stated.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain timestamp metadata from the original screenshot of the text message; obtain Hammer's source for the date.

claims.label: Josh Hammer Describes Sept 9 Zoom Call With Charlie Kirk and Rabbi
claims.claim: Per Josh Hammer on camera, approximately two hours after the "abandoning pro-Israel cause" text, a small Zoom call occurred with Charlie Kirk, Hammer, and others, organized by Charlie for messaging advice on Jewish-Christian relations on college campuses.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the other Zoom participants; cross-check against calendar records; obtain the "rabbi in Israel" identity.

claims.label: Frank Turek Describes Sept 8 Walk With Charlie Kirk Around 8:00 PM
claims.claim: Per Frank Turek on the Megyn Kelly Show, he went on a long walk with Charlie Kirk on Monday (September 8) at approximately 8:00 PM, after returning at Charlie's invitation.

claims.investigative_direction: Verify the email against the WikiLeaks Podesta archive; identify context and any related communications.

claims.label: Source States Dan Flood Text Was Sent as iMessage, Not Telegram
